title: Skin Care for Kanpur Weather: A Routine for Loo Summers, Humid Monsoons and Foggy Winters
ex: Dry, dusty loo summers, a sticky monsoon, smoky autumn weeks and cold, foggy winters: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Kanpur.
rt: Skin Care for Kanpur Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Kanpur weather: sun care for loo summers, lighter layers in the monsoon, night cleansing in smoky weeks and a richer routine for foggy winters.
quick: Kanpur is very hot, dry and dusty from April to June, humid from July to September, hazy in October and November, and cold and foggy from December to February. Use a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, a thin gel moisturiser in warm months, and a richer night cream, lip balm and warm baths in winter.
facts: Kanpur is on the inland Ganga plains of Uttar Pradesh
Late April to June brings dry heat and loo winds with dust
The monsoon usually runs from late June or July to September
December and January bring dense fog and cold mornings and nights
